* **Built against core 0.0.34**: requires `bankstatementparser >= 0.0.34`, the newest core release.
* **Dependencies refreshed**: pydantic 2.14.4 (pydantic-core 2.50.5), httpx2 and httpcore2 2.14.0 (2.16.2 on Python 3.11+), sse-starlette 3.5.1 (3.7.1 on 3.11+), lxml 6.1.3, pytz 2026.6 and four dev tools, plus cyclonedx-bom 9.0.0 for the release SBOM. The hashed requirements files are re-exported from the lock.
* **Suite Consistency covers the whole suite**: the scheduled check now reads all fourteen packages from PyPI and bankstatementparser.com from its latest GitHub release.
* **In lockstep with the suite's 0.0.35 release**: all fourteen packages and bankstatementparser.com ship 0.0.35 together, eight of the packages on PyPI for the first time.
